nodes.title: 1. portrait_protagonist_male - 正面

Subject: A young male cultivator around 20 years old, long hair tied in a high ponytail with a cyan jade hairpin, wearing a cyan Taoist robe with cream-white inner layer, a dark silk sash at the waist with jade pendant, holding a cyan-bladed sword in right hand behind back, sharp yet scholarly features, calm confident expression. The character occupies about 80 percent of the canvas, centered. Pure clean solid white background for easy background removal. Traditional Chinese ink wash painting style combined with rich gongbi coloring. cyan green, cream white, dark ink black, jade highlight color palette. No modern elements, no western fantasy, no anime style, no text, no watermarks, no duplicate characters, no full body (half-body only from waist up).
